name: magos
description: Multi-Agent Git Orchestrator (MAGOS) for Claude Code: the orchestrator skill, eight explicit Git commands (GitRecon, GitAnalyze, GitRecommend, GitIntegrate, GitCleanup, GitConverge, GitSweep, GitPlan), and the lane guard: PreToolUse hooks that check branch and worktree creation in every repository against the planned file manifests of the other lanes (opt out per repository with git config --local magos.guard off).
